findings.finding: TD2 projection is algebraically identical to the R2 BasisField projection but not bitwise identical. RC5Control removes c22 from the full inverse-selected projection, whereas BasisField uses a pseudoinverse. Supplemental 1024-record fixture measures max coefficient difference 4.996003610813204e-16 and normalized H row difference 3.410605131648481e-13. H rates and chronological nodal H states are bitwise identical. Do not describe TD2 H projection/rows as bitwise unchanged.

Committed RCControl tests omit td2 in inherited derivative/transport and H-row parity loops; its override of domain/storage test also omits inherited invalid-observation, wrong-source and query-domain assertions. Independent supplemental checks cover all three arms, all five shape domain refusals, ten invalid updates per arm and injected QR exceptions. No source change required for this narrow finite review; future maintenance would benefit from retaining these arm-wide regressions.

contract_audit: Only RC n, degree, nodes, p1, RC rates and corresponding state/root dimensions change. H degree m=3, H pairs, rates, public center/halfwidth, prior-free row semantics and source ownership remain inherited. No truth or fit-result imports are introduced.

For c22/tensor, H projection and normalized rows are bitwise identical to CompletedField on the supplemental fixture. All arms retain identical H nodal states and charge/path state. TD2 rounding difference is recorded separately.

Six-node RC rates/projection and RC rows/states match MixedField H7 bitwise. Native signature remains 11 arguments with separate n=6,m=3,b=6/7/9; contiguous float64 rates, projection, state and rows match C indexing and dimensions.

One joint root of width 52/54/58 is updated by the inherited transactional QR path. H/RC cross blocks remain nonzero; repeated-source/order and partial native failure leave root,state,count,noise unchanged in tested failures. rows() remains the inherited deliberate response-only API and does not accumulate root evidence.

Feature and endpoint derivative helpers use field.n, field.m and field.pairs and retain origin-chart coupling. Independent all-16-coordinate finite differences and physical amplitude-versus-chart endpoint comparisons pass for every arm. These test differentiation of the compressed model, not exact physical derivative accuracy.

Packed factors 11024/11880/13688 B plus456 B live response and96 B lower domain/scalars give11576/12432/14240 B. Retained NumPy arrays and scratch categories are separately reported. All controls exceed10 KiB before full overhead; no target feasibility, MCU timing or bounded reference-workspace claim follows.

checks.reproduction_script:
import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import numpy as np
from experiments.hysteresis_mixed_completion_001.rc_control import RC5Control
from experiments.hysteresis_mixed_completion_001.basis import CompletedField
from experiments.response_basis_attribution_001.basis import BasisField
from experiments.hysteresis_refinement_001.field import MixedField,build,features_jacobian,transported
from experiments.conditional_architecture_001.run import public_queries
from experiments.foster_uncertainty_audit_001.conditional_packet import chart_from

config=json.loads(Path('experiments/foster_feedback_001/calibration.json').read_text());config['hysteresis_chart']='bounded'
center,_,amps=public_queries(config)
k=np.arange(1024)
obs=np.column_stack((np.where(k%11==0,0.,(.3+(k%7))/35),np.where((k//19)%2,.06,-.04),np.full(1024,25.),3.7+.01*np.sin(k),.001+.0001*(k%3)))
x=chart_from(amps[1],center*np.exp([.1,-.2,.15,.3,-.25]))
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    binary=build(Path(td)/'native')
    for kind in ('td2','c22','tensor'):
        f=RC5Control(config,center,binary,kind)
        low=BasisField(config,center,binary) if kind=='td2' else CompletedField(config,center,binary,kind)
        h7=MixedField(config,center,1.,7,binary)
        rows=f.update(0,obs,return_rows=True);lr=low.rows(0,obs);hr=h7.rows(0,obs)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(rows[:,:39],hr[:,:39]);np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.state[:36],h7.state[:36])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.state[36:],low.state[18:])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(rows[:,39:],lr[:,21:],rtol=3e-13,atol=3e-12)
        if kind!='td2':np.testing.assert_array_equal(rows[:,39:],lr[:,21:])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.rates[18:],low.rates[9:])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f.p2,low.p2,rtol=3e-13,atol=3e-15)
        D=features_jacobian(f,x);end,F=transported(f,x)
        feature_err=transport_err=0.
        for j in range(16):
            xp=x.copy();xm=x.copy();xp[j]+=1e-6;xm[j]-=1e-6
            fd=(f.features(xp)-f.features(xm))/2e-6;ft=(transported(f,xp)[0]-transported(f,xm)[0])/2e-6
            np.testing.assert_allclose(fd,D[:,j],rtol=2e-6,atol=2e-7)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(ft,F[:,j],rtol=2e-6,atol=2e-7)
            feature_err=max(feature_err,float(np.max(abs(fd-D[:,j]))));transport_err=max(transport_err,float(np.max(abs(ft-F[:,j]))))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f.outgoing(x)[:4],end[:4],rtol=2e-13,atol=2e-13)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f.outgoing(x)[10],np.exp(x[13])*np.tanh(end[4]),rtol=2e-13,atol=2e-13)
        g=RC5Control(config,center,binary,kind)
        for first in range(0,len(obs),37):g.update(first,obs[first:first+37])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.state,g.state)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f.root.T@f.root,g.root.T@g.root,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-5)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f.root.T@f.root,rows.T@rows,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-5)
        assert np.linalg.norm((rows.T@rows)[3:39,39:-1])>1
        snap=(f.root.copy(),f.state.copy(),f.count,f.noise)
        bads=[]
        for col,value in [(0,-1.),(0,1.01),(1,.251),(2,24.),(3,float('nan')),(4,0.)]:
            bad=obs[:7].copy();bad[-1,col]=value;bads.append((1024,bad,None))
        bads.extend([(0,obs[:7],None),(1024,obs[:7],'wrong'),(1024,obs[:0],None),(1024,np.vstack([obs,obs[:1]]),None)])
        for first,data,source in bads:
            try:f.update(first,data,source)
            except ValueError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('rejection absent')
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.root,snap[0]);np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.state,snap[1]);assert (f.count,f.noise)==snap[2:]
        with patch('numpy.linalg.qr',side_effect=np.linalg.LinAlgError('review injection')):
            try:f.update(1024,obs[:7])
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('QR injection absent')
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.root,snap[0]);np.testing.assert_array_equal(f.state,snap[1]);assert (f.count,f.noise)==snap[2:]
        for i in range(5):
            s=center.copy();s[i]*=np.exp(1.001)
            try:f.evaluate(amps[1],s)
            except ValueError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('domain rejection absent')
        st=f.storage();assert st['live_response_B']==456
        results.append(dict(kind=kind,observations=1024,chunk_size=37,h_row_abs_difference=float(np.max(abs(rows[:,39:]-lr[:,21:]))),h_projection_abs_difference=float(np.max(abs(f.p2-low.p2))),feature_jacobian_abs_difference=feature_err,transport_jacobian_abs_difference=transport_err,rejected_updates=len(bads),QR_failure_atomic=True,storage=st))
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'arms':results},indent=2))
